decisions.reason: Allowing Advanced components where Basic alternatives are unavailable does not change the connector placement, orientation, clearance, or accessibility rules.
The sourcing-tier policy does not change the required I2C speed, pull-up values, resistor policy, or topology, and no specific I2C component is identified as affected.
The source permits a broader manufacturing component tier but does not alter the panel-control connector inventory, signals, or mounting policy.
No charge-status component is specifically replaced or reconfigured; the LED, connector, resistor, and interface requirements remain valid unchanged.
The legacy interboard alignment requirement was already eliminated by the integrated-board architecture, and the Advanced-component policy adds no further state change.
The component sourcing-tier decision does not change the ESP32 antenna edge-placement requirement.
The source does not alter the panel power button, connector type, PWRON connection, mounting, or control behavior.
The general acceptance of Advanced components does not resolve the existing monitor-device ambiguity or change the required rails, coverage, or monitor configuration.
